text: Appeal of Order to Comply (December 20, 2017) for 1220 Ellesmere Road, 19.

Property Standards Committee, Scarborough Panel: 1. Confirmed the order to comply, dated December 20, 2017, for 1220 Ellesmere Road, 19, Folder No: 17 261633 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to July 3, 2018, to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City. 2. Directed that the back handrails (part of Item 3 on the Order) be temporarily repaired for safety reasons, and granted an extension to March 1, 2018, to complete the temporary repair.
